book.name: 1 Abhakoriinto
book.title: Enyaarubha yo okutaanga ya Pauro ku Bhakoriinto

content: Obhuturo bhwe Ekoro Muhoreeru
Bhoono, abhahiiri bhaane, ndagaamba iguru yo obhuturo okurwa kwe Ekoro Muhoreeru, kwo okubha ndaseega mubhumenye bhuzomu.
Mumenyiri kubha hano mwaari mukyaari abhaatu bhano bhatamumenyiri Taatabhugya, mukangʼeenwa no okukaangatwa kwo okuseengera emisaambwa gyo okubhaazwa, yiingabha emisaambwa gitana obhuhoru!

Kweego, ndabhabhuurira omuutu wowoosi wuno akukaangatwa ne Ekoro wa Taatabhugya atakunagya okugaamba, “Yeesu yiihiimirwe.” Kweeki omuutu wowoosi atakunagya okugaamba, “Yeesu ni Mukuru,” eraabhe atakukaangatwa ne Ekoro Muhoreeru.
Bhuriho obhuturo bhwa tuubho maanga maaru, nawe Ekoro Muhoreeru wuno akutwaania obhuturo bhuyo ni wuyowuyo.
Kweeki turamuhokeerya Omukuru kwa tuubho maanga maaru, nawe Omukuru wuno tukumuhokeerya ni wuyowuyo.
Kweeki turakora emirimo gya tuubho nzaru, nawe Taatabhugya wuno akutusakirya twoosi kukora emirimo giyo ni wuyowuyo.
Ekoro Muhoreeru ariikuundukura kubhaatu bhoosi, okubha abhaatu bhoosi bhabhe bharabhona obhweera.
Ekoro Muhoreeru aramuha omuutu wumwe okugaamba amangʼana ga amangʼeeni, owuundi aramuha amangʼana go obhumenyi.
Ekoro Muhoreeru wuyowuyo aramuha owuundi obhuturo bhwo okubha no obhwiikirirya bhukuru, owuundi obhuturo bhwo okuhorya,

owuundi obhuturo bhwo okukora ebhitiika, owuundi obhuturo bhwo okuruusya obhurooti. Ekoro Muhoreeru wuyowuyo aramuha owuundi obhuturo bhwo okumenya eraabhe amangʼana garwiiri kuziikoro eziimbiihu kasi kwe Ekoro Muhoreeru, owuundi obhuturo bhwo okugaamba ebhigaambo ebhiindi, owuundi obhuturo bhwo okugarura ebhigaambo bhiyo.
Ekoro Muhoreeru wuyowuyo owumwe arakora emirimo giyo gyoosi. Ewe aramuha omuutu wuyo woosi obhuturo bhwaaye, kyeego akuseega omweene.
Omubhiri gumwe, ebhiimo bhyaaru
Omubhiri gwo omuutu gune ebhiimo bhyaaru, nawe ebhiimo bhiyo ni mubhiri gumwe. Niigo eri kumubhiri gwa Krisito nigwe ekanisa.

Niragaamba ego, kwo okubha etwe twoosi, tubhe Abhayahudi kasi tubhe abhaatu bhe ebhyaaro ebhiindi, tubhe abhagya kasi tubhe abhiiragaanzi, tukabatiizwa kwe Ekoro Muhoreeru wumwe no okuhaabhwa Ekoro wuyo owumwe, okubha tubhe omubhiri gumwe.
Ambe, omubhiri gutana ekiimo kimwe ego, nawe gune ebhiimo bhyaaru.
Kyeego okuguru kuungagaambiri, “Enye nitari kubhoko, kweego enye nitari hagiro ho omubhiri,” gutiingabheeri hagiro ho omubhiri kwe ekigirirye kiyo eheene?
Nakwo okutwi kuungagaambiri kubha, “Enye nitari riiso, kweego enye nitari hagiro ho omubhiri,” kutiingabheeri hagiro ho omubhiri kwe ekigirirye kiyo eheene?
Eraabhe omubhiri gwoosi guungabheeri eriiso, omuutu yaranagyabhwi okwiigwa? Kasi omubhiri gwoosi guungabheeri okutwi, omuutu yaari aranagyabhwi okwiihuziirirya?
Nawe bhoono, Taatabhugya yabhituuriri ebhiimo bhyoosi kumubhiri, kyeego bhurya yaseegiri omweene.
Eraabhe ebhiimo bhyoosi bhiingabheeri kiimo kimwe, omubhiri gutiingabheeri mubhiri.
Nawe ebhiimo ni bhyaaru, nawe omubhiri ni gumwe.
Eriiso ritakunagya kubhuurira okubhoko, “Awe nitakukweenda.” Naabhe omutwe gutakunagya kubhuurira amaguru, “Emwe nitakubheenda.”
Kutuuma gayo, ebhiimo bhyo omubhiri bhino bhikurorekana, ni bhinyookobhu, nibhyo bhikweenderwa bhukongʼu.

Kweeki ebhiimo bhino bhikurorekana kubha, bhitakungʼarira okusuukwa, nibhyo tukubhisuuka bhukongʼu. Ebhiimo bhyo omubhiri gweetu kyeego bhikurorekana kubha, bhirareeta eziisoni, nibhyo tukubhituga bhukongʼu,
hano ebhiimo bhino bhitakureeta eziisoni, bhitakweenderwa kutugwa kyeego ebhiindi. Taatabhugya omweene agutuuriri bhuzomu omubhiri. Ebhiimo bhino bhitakusuukwa bhukongʼu, abhikoriri bhisuukwe,
okubha omubhiri gutatwaanikana, nawe ekiimo ekimwe kisakiranie ne ekiimo ekiindi kyaku.
Eraabhe ekiimo kimwe kyo omubhiri kikunyahaarika, bhyoosi bhiranyahaarika hamwe nakyo. Kweeki ekiimo kimwe kikukumibhwa, bhyoosi bhirazomererwa hamwe nakyo.
Ambe, emwe mwoosi ni mubhiri gwa Krisito, na bhoosi ni kiimo kumubhiri guyo.

Taatabhugya akatuura abheega mukanisa, bha kabhiri abharooti, bha katatu abheegya. Kweeki atuuriri bhano bhakukora ebhitiika, bho obhuturo bhwo okuhorya abharweeri, bho obhuturo bhwo okubhasakirya abhaandi, bho obhuturo bhwo okukaangata, na bho obhuturo bhwo okutorima ebhigaambo ebhiindi.
Bhoono, abhaatu bhoosi ni bheega? Abhaatu bhoosi ni bharooti? Abhaatu bhoosi ni bheegya? Abhaatu bhoosi bharakora ebhitiika?
Kweeki, abhaatu bhoosi bhane obhuturo bhwo okuhorya abharweeri? Abhaatu bhoosi bharatorima ebhigaambo ebhiindi? Abhaatu bhoosi bhano obhuturo bhwo okugarura ebhigaambo bhiyo?
Ambe, mwiigoombe kubhona obhuturo bhukuru. Nawe hiinga ndeenda kubhabhuurira enzira yino ni nzomu bhukongʼu.
